skills.trigger: When evaluating a chest X-ray with focal pulmonary nodules to determine precise anatomical localization and distinguish specific patterns from diffuse or pleural disease.
steps: Inspect the frontal view for discrete nodular opacities and assess their relationship to adjacent mediastinal structures.
Identify silhouetting of the right heart border to localize a nodule to the right middle lobe.
Identify opacities visible behind the cardiac shadow (retrocardiac) on the frontal view and confirm posterior location on the lateral view.
Distinguish this specific dual-location pattern (RML + retrocardiac) from options describing diffuse miliary distribution, perihilar infiltrates, cavitary lesions, or pleural effusions.
